core_obligations: Monic polynomial lift: the integral relation of the finite morphism lifts to a monic polynomial at a finite level (coefficient stabilization).
Finiteness transitivity: finiteness of the finite-level morphism composed with the transition gives finiteness for all later indices; conclude eventual finiteness.
difficulty_reason: Monic polynomial lift + finiteness transitivity: two mechanisms, each short.

compared.difference: The sibling is the closed immersion version (surjective ring maps); this is the finite morphism version (monic relations). Different statements.
